meta.name: viral-hooks
meta.description: Write and critique viral hooks for short-form video: the opening 1 to 3 seconds that decide whether anything else gets seen. Use this when you need a batch of hook ideas for a video, want to make a weak opening line stronger, are picking which hook archetype fits an idea, or want a critique of a draft hook against proven patterns. Covers the three-layer hook (visual, verbal, on-screen text), the named-creator frameworks (Kallaway, MrBeast, Hormozi, Brunson, Koe, Welsh, Bush, Galloway), scroll-stopping hook tactics, and the anti-patterns that tank first-three-seconds retention. Works across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Pattern-based guidance that improves the odds. It does not guarantee virality.

copy.tagline: 写出短视频前3秒的爆款钩子
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做短视频总在开头留不住观众
copy.tagline_en: Write viral hooks for short-form video openings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you struggle to hook viewers in the first 3 seconds of your videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你写出或修改短视频开头1到3秒的钩子，包括画面、台词和屏幕文字三层，并提供多种钩子类型和创作者框架。
howto.when: 当你需要为视频想一批钩子、想让一个弱开头变强、想判断哪种钩子适合某个点子，或者想评估一个草稿钩子时触发。

say.text: 给我6个钩子，关于一款39美元的可重复使用冷泡咖啡机。
say.note: Claude会返回多个钩子，每个包含台词、画面和屏幕文字。

say.text: 这个开头太弱了，帮我改强：'今天我要给大家介绍一个好东西'。
say.note: Claude会诊断问题并给出三个改写版本。

say.text: 这个钩子适合用哪种类型？'我花了400美元买咖啡设备'。
say.note: Claude会匹配两三种钩子类型并各写一个示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write or improve the first 1 to 3 seconds of a short-form video hook, covering visual, verbal, and on-screen text layers, with multiple hook archetypes and creator frameworks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a batch of hook ideas for a video, want to strengthen a weak opening, are choosing which hook archetype fits an idea, or want a critique of a draft hook.

say_en.text: Give me 6 hooks for a $39 reusable cold brew maker.
say_en.note: Claude returns multiple hooks with verbal line, visual, and text.

say_en.text: This opening is weak, make it stronger: 'Today I want to introduce a great product'.
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses and rewrites three variants.

say_en.text: Which hook archetype fits this idea? 'I spent $400 on coffee gear'.
say_en.note: Claude matches two or three archetypes and writes an example for each.
